extracted.subtask_short: peer review training for early-career researchers
extracted.subtask_description: A structured online course (Publons / Web of Science Academy) teaching core competencies of scholarly peer review through 10 modules, practical activities, and mentor-facilitated co-review. Designed to train participants to write constructive, methodologically and ethically informed reviews and to interact effectively with editors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry knowledge
rubrics_metrics.description: Industry knowledge (one of the course coverage areas).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the course structure: the curriculum covers understanding the scholarly publishing landscape, the role and functions of peer review, journal selection, and types of peer review so reviewers can situate individual reviews within broader industry norms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review skills
rubrics_metrics.description: Review skills (one of the course coverage areas).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Core competencies such as critical reading, assessing contributions and novelty, methodological and statistical critique, writing constructive comments, and making decision recommendations are taught and practised.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical activities (one of the course coverage areas).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participants practice writing actual reviews of papers published in their field as part of skill development; hands-on exercises are central to learning.

rubrics_metrics.name: The role of peer review in scholarly communication
rubrics_metrics.description: Understand the role of peer review in scholarly communication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Module topic: familiarise with why peer review exists, its functions, limitations and impact on research dissemination and quality assurance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal selection and types of peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: Journal selection and types of peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Module topic: learn how to select appropriate journals for submissions and understand different peer review models (e.g., single-blind, double-blind, open) and how model choice affects review expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflicts of interest and ethical responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Conflicts of interest and ethical responsibilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Module topic: recognise and declare conflicts of interest, understand ethical responsibilities of reviewers (confidentiality, fair assessment, avoiding misuse of privileged information).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reading the paper critically
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Module topic: techniques for critical reading, identifying strengths and weaknesses, and efficiently extracting key claims, evidence, and structure from a manuscript.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identifying contributions and assessing novelty
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Module topic: determine what the paper adds to the literature, evaluate the significance and novelty of claims, and distinguish incremental versus substantive advances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodological evaluation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Module topic: assess study design, experimental or analytical methods, validity of procedures, appropriateness of controls, reproducibility, and limitations of the methodology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical review principles
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Module topic: evaluate statistical analyses, sample size/power considerations, correct application of tests, reporting of uncertainty, and whether conclusions are supported by the data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing constructive review comments
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Module topic: craft clear, actionable, and respectful feedback for authors; balance criticism with constructive suggestions and distinguish major versus minor issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision recommendations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Module topic: form and justify recommendations to editors (e.g., accept, revise, reject) based on assessment of novelty, methods, and overall quality; provide reasoning to support the recommendation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Working with editors and post-review process
rubrics_metrics.description: Working with editors and post-review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Module topic: understand the editor–reviewer relationship, how editorial decisions are made, confidentiality and timing expectations, and how to handle post-review communications or appeals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mentorship and co-review
rubrics_metrics.description: Mentorship and co-review with a mentor (facilitated by the course).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Publons Academy facilitated co-review with a mentor; finishing the course with a mentor's endorsement allows participants to build a verified peer review profile. Mentorship is presented as a mechanism for supervised practice and endorsement.
